The '''4th Wing Guard''' was a [[Cloud car/Legends|cloud car]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] assigned to the [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Wing Guard]]&mdash;a [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|security force]] working to protect [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] from the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]].

==History==
Around [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], the 4th Wing Guard fought back against the corruption growing among the security forces of the New Republic. When [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kyle Katarn]] traveled to Bespin, they found Cloud City an open battleground between its natives and Imperial Remnant forces. A successor to the [[3rd Wing Guard]], the 4th Wing Guard assisted the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in liberating Cloud City.<ref name="Outcast">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast]]''</ref>

==Description==
Based in [[Cloud City Security Tower]] on Bespin's Cloud City,<ref name="BWGITDB" /> the 4th Wing Guard's [[Storm IV Twin-Pod cloud car/Legends|cloud cars]] were painted [[Color/Legends|orange]] and offered moderate protection to the pilots who flew them at the expense of targeting accuracy.<ref name="SWPM" />

==Behind the scenes==
The 4th Wing Guard was represented by a miniature in the ''[[Scum & Villainy]]'' expansion of the ''[[Star Wars PocketModel TCG]]''.<ref name="SWPM" />
